Data Center Ethernet Switch
02
The S6500 series data center switches is a new generation of high-performance, high-density, high speed, high reliability data center-level Ethernet switch products independently developed by UNIPOE for data centers and cloud computing networks.
Our products are mainly aimed at enterprise data center that require high network scalability and flexibility, as well as operator data center and Internet cloud service provider data center that require high performance, high reliability, lossless transmission, and intelligent operation and maintenance.
